title: Review of Sketch Easel Video
content: The current issue ofImagineFX magazinereviews my sketch easel video:"Compared with the typical artist's easel you can buy, James's design is more portable and more adjustable, as well as being perfect for holding the paints and paper he uses. When you watch him working on location, you're struck by how unobtrusive the easel is."If you want to make your own, you can get a copy of "How to Make a Sketch Easel".The 1080p HD download isavailable for just $14.95 from Gumroad.The DVD version is available for $24.50, and it includes a slide show.The DVD is alsoavailable on Amazonordirect from the manufacturer at Kunaki.
